title: Our Orchestras
description: Six leveled ensembles at Alpharetta High School — Concert, Silver, Philharmonia, Sinfonia, Symphony, and Chamber — with placement requirements for each.

blocks.title: Six ensembles
blocks.lede: Every student is placed by audition into the group that fits where they are now, and moves up as they grow. All six rehearse during the school day, so orchestra fits alongside sports and clubs.
